news.title: Olatech Solutions Limited Announces Reconstitution of Board Committees
news.body: Olatech Solutions Limited at its meeting held on February 16, 2026, approved the reconstitution of the Audit Committee, Nomination and Remuneration Committee, and Stakeholder Relationship and Grievances Committee. The Audit Committee comprises Mr. Vijay Mukesh Thakkar as Chairman (Non-Executive Independent Director), Mrs. Vasantiben Jayantibhai Menat as Member (Non-Executive Independent Director), and Mr. Amit Kumar Singh as Member (Managing Director). The Nomination and Remuneration Committee comprises Mrs. Vasantiben Jayantibhai Menat as Chairman (Non-Executive Independent Director), Mr. Vijay Mukesh Thakkar as Member (Non-Executive Independent Director), and Mr. Naved Iqbal as Member (Non-Executive Director). Either way, risk is elevated with these companies because there is a chance the product may not come to fruition or the company's addressable market or demand may not be as large as expected. news.title: New minor risk - Profit margin trend
news.body: The company's profit margins are lower than last year and have reduced by more than 30%. Net profit margin: 13% Last year net profit margin: 25% This is considered a minor risk. A large drop in profit margin could indicate the company does not have strong competitive advantages or it is yet to establish itself and its core business. Even if it is a well established business, this may make it a much riskier investment than one that has a combination of proven competitive advantages and a stable or growing profit margin. news.body: The company's share price has been highly volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 90% of Indian stocks, typically moving 9.2% a week. This is considered a major risk.
